new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Only one work is listed for this item and it was fully opened and read (so the 'spot-check two silent works' instruction has one candidate, which I checked in full): nothing on stress was missed. The chapter has no prosodic statement beyond the generic p. 226 tone remark and the p. 225 ATR note, neither about Bangwinji. Not added as works (out of scope): other files already held by the project under from earlier passes (Kleinewillinghöfer Tula-Waja wordlists, Adelberger 2024, Blench Atlas) were not re-checked here.

sources.citation: Elstermann, Julius-Maximilian. 2021. Nominale Klassifikation im Tula-Waja: Erste Schritte zur Rekonstruktion des Genus-Systems im Tula. Abschlussarbeit (M.A.), Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Institut für Afrika- und Asienwissenschaften (Erstprüfer Tom Güldemann, Zweitprüferin Elisabeth Verhoeven), 15 Nov 2021. ii+185 pp. PDF hosted by LLACAN (AdaGram project).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No phonology of Bangwinji. Tone-marked Bangwinji forms are cited without comment. On Tula (not Bangwinji) it states that no tone analysis exists: 'Die fehlende Tonanalyse einerseits, und die begrenzten Beispiele mit verlässlicher Tondokumentation andererseits liefern für systematische Aussagen für die tonale Struktur schlichtweg keine Grundlage.' (pp. 19-20, §3.1.1.3), and that Kleinewillinghöfer 2006 fn. 6 warns of tonal distortion in Tula citation forms. Nothing on stress/accent anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent Akzent/Betonung/stress: 0 hits).

sources.note: Exactly 4 entries coded [bsj]: Blench n.d. [1999] Atlas of Nigerian Languages (overview); Kleinewillinghöfer 1996 'Die nordwestlichen Adamawa-Sprachen' (overview;comparative;minimal); Kleinewillinghöfer 2014 'Tula-Waja group' (overview;comparative;wordlist); Adelberger 2024 (ethnographic). Name search adds only Adelberger 1994 (overview) and Wente-Lukas 1985 handbook. No phonology, grammar or grammar sketch entry exists for bsj. Descriptive works in the group exist only for Waja (Kleinewillinghöfer 1991) and Tula (Lukas 1955/56; Blench 2020).
